quantization_endpoint_enumeration.reduction: each estimator uses a cell only through its five-value mean, so assignments with the same high-endpoint count are exactly equivalent

analysis_contract.variant_adoption_warning: these values must not be used to adopt a variant

C1.overturned_if: any Holm-adjusted linear test ceases to reject, c2 reaches zero, a leave-one-point-out c2 reaches zero, or quadratic lack-of-fit rejects

C10.overturned_if: f is replaced by a direct, validated observation of instantaneous running-thread count

C11.overturned_if: the prior-insight relationship and adaptive-scope wording are audited outside this numeric script

C12.overturned_if: measurement-time provenance and present-source compatibility are both independently audited; report fields alone are insufficient

C13.overturned_if: a displayed quantity lacks its declared unit, interval triplet, or abs(delta log alpha)x100 metric definition

C14.overturned_if: the parent verifies the separate documentation projection and confirms no decisions fragment is needed

C2.overturned_if: all three subclaims acquire direct observations and compatible goodness-of-fit

C2a_definitions_and_nominal_accounting.overturned_if: abort-rate semantics, worker count, or one-wait-per-counted-abort semantics differ from the frozen contract

C2b_constant_cost_and_empirical_closure.overturned_if: the closure enters the simultaneous repeat band for every workload and remains stable under quantization and one-point exclusion

C2c_causality.overturned_if: the listed diagnostic observations identify or reject the proposed mediation under a preregistered design

C3.overturned_if: the closure obtains a uniquely lower same-contract score with a score-difference interval excluding zero against every alternative

C4.overturned_if: the stated fitted-model parameter substitution no longer changes the window slope under the same objective

C5.overturned_if: f becomes independently observed and theta is identified by a design that does not algebraically reuse alpha

C6.overturned_if: the constrained family passes goodness-of-fit or an unrestricted point estimate or recording-quantization endpoint is nonnegative

C7.overturned_if: the paired score-difference interval excludes zero for at least one workload under the same score contract

C8.overturned_if: a reported abort value is not rounded to resolution 0.0001 or an estimator depends on within-cell endpoint ordering discarded by the exact reduction

C9.overturned_if: any stated asymptotic condition fails or measurements beyond the current right censor directly show another limiting form

units.f: dimensionless; residual non-nominal-backoff share of 48-worker aggregate time
